variants.text: Adult male with an oval face, dark hair, thin mustache, and facial stubble.
Adult male with an oval face, high forehead, and straight eyebrows. He has short dark hair and facial hair styled as a thin mustache and stubble along the jaw.

Male adult with an oval face and high forehead with a rounded hairline. Features include straight eyebrows, almond-shaped eyes with defined double eyelid creases, and a straight nasal dorsum with a rounded tip. He has medium-thickness lips with a defined cupid's bow and a short philtrum. The jawline is narrow with a rounded chin. Facial hair includes a short, dark thin mustache and stubble along the jaw, matching his short dark hair.

A man with an oval-shaped face and short dark hair. He has a high forehead, straight eyebrows, and almond-shaped eyes. He also has a thin mustache and some short dark stubble growing along his jawline.
